description:
One line of a session usage log: what one agent session spent on one ticket.

The usage fields match a capture run's; ``cost_usd`` is null when the model's price
is unknown. Other fields a hook writes (session id, models, cache tokens) are kept.

input_tokens.description: null: unknown; a failed Source that leaves it out is unknown too, others spent 0
input_tokens.title: Input Tokens

output_tokens.description: null: unknown; a failed Source that leaves it out is unknown too, others spent 0
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
